every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited

PF-592379, a small basic amine with an ether-containing saturated heterocycle, had predicted human F >60%, dog F 61%, and rat F 28%, all at or above the 20% threshold.

Pethidine and pentazocine F values of 0.80 and 0.68–0.70 were measured in cirrhosis, where reduced first-pass metabolism increases F; these are less transferable to a healthy query but still not evidence of low F.
No active record provides affirmative evidence of F < 20% for a relevant analog; the lowest reported values are at or just above the threshold.
